goods.name: Sandstone
goods.use: Crushed into dirt for bricks at the Stone Crusher; rubble aggregate in concrete; sandstone masonry construction.

goods.name: Limestone
goods.use: Cement recipe; metallurgical flux for steel; limestone masonry construction.

goods.name: Brick
goods.use: Fired from dirt and water at the Cement Kiln; brick plinths, walls and chimneys of the buildings that show them (material cost rule); brick masonry blocks.

goods.name: Cement
goods.use: Concrete recipe; mortar for sandstone and brick masonry.

goods.name: Concrete
goods.use: Permanent quarries; advanced factory, civic, science and rocket foundations; levees; reinforced dam blocks; overflow dams; overhangs; scaffolds.

sources.name: Sandstone Outcrop
sources.description: A finite sandstone deposit. A Sandstone Pit in range digs it out.
sources.flavor: Easy to dig, and gone before you know it.

sources.name: Limestone Outcrop
sources.description: A finite limestone deposit. A Limestone Pit in range digs it out.
sources.flavor: Shells of creatures long gone, waiting to become cement.

sources.name: Deep Sandstone Seam
sources.description: An endless sandstone seam. Build a Sandstone Quarry over it.

sources.name: Deep Limestone Seam
sources.description: An endless limestone seam. Build a Limestone Quarry over it.
sources.flavor: An ancient sea left plenty behind.

buildings.name: Sandstone Pit
buildings.description: Digs sandstone from outcrops within its range until they run out. A Sandstone Quarry later gives an endless supply.

buildings.name: Limestone Pit
buildings.description: Digs limestone from outcrops within its range until they run out. A Limestone Quarry later gives an endless supply.
buildings.flavor: Every bucket of limestone is a future bag of cement.

buildings.name: Sandstone Quarry
buildings.description: Quarries sandstone without end. Build it over a Deep Sandstone Seam.
buildings.flavor: The seam goes deeper than anyone has dared to dig.

buildings.name: Limestone Quarry
buildings.description: Quarries limestone without end. Build it over a Deep Limestone Seam.
buildings.flavor: Old sea floor, new town square.

buildings.name: Stone Crusher
buildings.description: Grinds sandstone into dirt for the Cement Kiln to fire into bricks.
buildings.flavor: Rocks go in loud and come out quiet.

buildings.name: Cement Kiln
buildings.description: Burns logs to fire dirt into bricks, and limestone with bricks into cement.
buildings.flavor: Hot enough to bake bricks, and the crew's lunch.

buildings.name: Concrete Mixer
buildings.description: Mixes sandstone, cement and water into concrete.
buildings.flavor: Keep it turning, or keep a chisel handy.
